sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run of form. Sandbach have won seven of their last ten games and sit top of the table with 22 points, while visitors Alsager Town are bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and arrive on the back of a five-game losing streak.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications if Sandbach slip up. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face Eccleshall at home in a clash between two strong teams. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local derby between mid-table sides. Bilston Town, fifth in the standings, welcome Foley Meir in a match featuring two teams in decent form. Barnton entertain Shawbury United, with Barnton's recent win suggesting they have momentum, while Shawbury have lost four of their last five. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, a fixture between two sides struggling in the lower half. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half clash between teams both winless in recent matches. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another low-table encounter. Brereton Social play Widnes Town at home, facing pointless Widnes who have gone five consecutive matches without a win.
